ui.sharing.hero.sub: Only what you turn on goes to SmartThings and Telegram
ui.sharing.session.hint: Sends the lock state and idle time to the hub for routines
ui.sharing.user.hint: Also sends the signed-in Windows account name
ui.sharing.nowplaying.hint: Sends title, artist and app. Off, only whether something plays
ui.sharing.activity.hint: Sends only whether the listed programs run
ui.sharing.watch.priority: Lower numbers win. Routines pick them as 'Watch 1–5' on the PC device
ui.sharing.watch.hint: File names only, no path. Removing one breaks routines using its slot
ui.sharing.watch.full: All five slots are taken. Remove one to add another
ui.sharing.pick.hint: Shown on this PC only, never sent anywhere
ui.sharing.pick.more: %d more. Search by name to narrow them down
